raw_text: Pakistan descending into political crisis. Former PM Imran Khan arrested at court, sparking violent protests across multiple cities. PTI supporters targeting military installations. This is the most serious civil-military confrontation in Pakistan since the 1971 crisis. International community urging restraint.
